lines.text: It’s project time! Today you will plan, build and check your own fan page or club page.
Real web designers draw a quick sketch called a wireframe first.
Draw boxes for the title and each section, and write what goes in them.
Coding is much faster when you know what you are building.
The section tag wraps a heading and everything that belongs with it.
Three sections make three clear parts, like About, What we do and Join us.
One CSS rule can style every section at once.
Pick two or three colours and one font, and use them everywhere.
Matching colours and fonts make a page look calm and professional.
Using too many different colours makes a page feel messy.
Before anyone sees your page, check that every picture has alt text and a credit.
Click every link to make sure it works.
Make sure there are no personal details anywhere.
Each section tag holds one heading and the content that belongs with it.
Three sections give your page three clear parts that are easy to read.
This one rule picks every section on the page.
Change the border colour here, and all three boxes change together.
First sketch your page, then build the HTML without any styles.
Next add your colours and font in one style tag.
Finally run the safety checklist, press Check, and submit with your reflection.
Here is the checklist real web teams use before a page goes live.
If any line is not ticked, fix it before you share.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
